title: 第三十章收获颇丰
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
料理完，叶凡拍了拍手，抬头望向雷劫地最中心。

    那里的天都有些发暗，一道粗大的残雷抽打着大地，动静比外围大了十倍不止。

    任务铜牌上的指引，就指向那儿。

    那只值五十块灵石的异化雷火玄鸡，该是在那里。

    叶凡不再耽搁，迈开步子，朝雷光最盛的地界走去。

    一踏进核心，周围豁然一变。

    密集的雷光连成一道银幕，将整片区域罩住。

    狂暴的雷电气息扑面而来，寻常修士光是站在这儿，灵气都得被电的溃散。

    叶凡却在逛自家后院。

    那些能把岩石劈成粉末的残雷，落在他身上，连衣服都烧不穿了，只炸开一团细碎火花，带来一阵阵酥麻。

    他甚至感觉得到，二转过的肉身正贪婪的吞着这些雷电之力，筋骨皮膜都在微微发烫，更结实了几分。

    这地方，对旁人是死地，对他倒成了块练肉身的宝地。

    就在这时，雷幕中心传来一声尖锐鸣叫。

    一只体型堪比猎犬的大鸡，从一块焦黑巨岩后头冲了出来。

    它通体覆着一层暗红色的角质甲片，两只翅膀缠着肉眼可见的电光，一双爪子锋利如钩。

    那股从它身上散出来的气息，狂暴凶悍，半只脚已经踏进了凝气的门槛。

    异化雷火玄鸡。

    它把叶凡当成了入侵者，一双凶戾的眼睛死死的锁住他。

    喔！

    玄鸡长鸣一声，张开鸟喙，一道雷电与火焰交织的光束，猛的喷向叶凡。

    叶凡没躲。

    他想试试这身皮肉的底子。

    轰。

    雷火光束结结实实轰在他胸口，炸成一团刺眼的光。

    脚下焦土被炸开一个浅坑，他本人只晃了一下，一步都没退。

    胸口的衣服化成飞灰，露出的皮肤上只留下一道浅白印子，连皮都没破。

    “就这点力道？”

    叶凡咧嘴一笑。

    对面那只雷火玄鸡，直接看傻了。

    它那双凶眼里头，头一回露出了近似惊疑的神色。

    这招雷火吐息是它的杀手锏，眼前这两脚兽，气息弱的可怜，怎么半点事没有？

    它不信邪，又是接连两道雷火光束喷过来。
content_en:
After finishing cooking, Ye Fan clapped his hands and looked up at the center of the Thunder Tribulation Land.

    The sky there was a little dark, and a thick residual thunder struck the ground. The movement was more than ten times louder than outside.

    The guidance on the mission bronze medal points there.

    The alienated thunder-fire black chicken worth fifty spiritual stones should be there.

    Ye Fan stopped delaying and walked towards the land where the thunder was the brightest.

    As soon as I stepped into the core, the surroundings suddenly changed.

    The dense lightning formed a screen, covering the entire area.

    The violent thunder and lightning aura rushed towards the face. Just standing here, the spiritual energy of ordinary monks would be shattered by the electricity.

    Ye Fan was visiting his backyard.

    Those remnant thunders that could split rocks into powder fell on him, and they couldn't even burn through his clothes. They only exploded into a ball of fine sparks, causing waves of numbness.

    He could even feel that his turned body was greedily swallowing the power of thunder and lightning, and his muscles, bones, and skin were getting slightly hot and a little stronger.

    This place was a place of death to others, but to him it became a treasured place for physical training.

    At this moment, a sharp cry came from the center of the thunder curtain.

    A chicken as big as a hunting dog rushed out from behind a huge black rock.

    Its entire body was covered with a layer of dark red horny armor, its two wings were wrapped with visible electric light, and its claws were as sharp as hooks.

    The aura emanating from it was violent and fierce, and half of its feet had already stepped into the threshold of Qi Condensation.

    Alienated Thunder Fire Black Chicken.

    It regarded Mark as an intruder, and locked a pair of ferocious eyes on him.

    oh!

    The black chicken crowed, opened its beak, and a beam of lightning and flames shot towards Ye Fan.

    Ye Fan didn't hide.

    He wanted to try out the foundation of this body.

    boom.

    The thunderbolt beam hit his chest firmly, exploding into a ball of dazzling light.

    A shallow crater was opened in the scorched earth under his feet, and he only staggered for a moment without taking a step back.

    The clothes on the chest turned into fly ash, leaving only a light white mark on the exposed skin, without even breaking the skin.

    "Is this enough strength?"

    Ye Fan grinned.

    The Thunder Fire Black Chicken opposite was dumbfounded.

    For the first time, there was a look of surprise in its fierce eyes.

    This breath of thunder and fire is its trump card. The two-legged beasts in front of them have pitifully weak breaths. Why are they not doing anything?

    It didn't believe in evil, and two more beams of thunder and fire were sprayed over.
